process.heading: Från idé till merch — i 4 steg
process.subtext: Hela processen tar mindre än 15 minuter. Priser visas direkt — inga samtal eller förhandlingar.

1.title: Välj en produkt
1.body: Bläddra i katalogen med riktiga priser. Priset uppdateras direkt vid ändring av antal eller trycktyp.

2.title: Anpassa online
2.body: Ladda upp logotypen, placera den på produkten, välj tryckszon. Editorn visar exakta kostnader i realtid.

3.title: Få offert
3.body: Fyll i formuläret — en account manager kontaktar dig inom 2 timmar. Fast pris utan dolda kostnader.

4.title: Ta emot merch
4.body: Produktion 7–14 arbetsdagar. Leverans. Om något är fel — gör vi om det gratis.

designer.label: Design service
designer.heading: No logo? We'll help
designer.desc: Our designer will adapt your logo for printing or create a brand identity from scratch. Result — in 2 days.

0.title: Tell us about your brand
0.body: Send your logo, brand colors and style description. If you have nothing — just tell us about the company. The brief takes 10–15 minutes online or by phone.

1.title: Get a concept
1.body: The designer will prepare 2–3 adaptation options for printing on clothing. Deadline — 2 business days. Includes adaptation for silk-screen, embroidery and DTF.

2.title: Approve and order
2.body: Choose an option, make edits (up to 2 rounds included), receive final files. All files stay with you — for any future orders.

customizer.label: Online constructor
customizer.heading: Build your merch right in the interface
customizer.desc: Real workspace for selecting product, color, prints, layers and volume pricing before placing an order.

trust.heading: Why they trust us
trust.subtext: Not just words — specific guarantees we uphold every day.

0.title: Quality guarantee
0.body: If the product doesn't match the approved design — we redo it for free. No arguments, no bureaucracy.

1.title: Own production
1.body: We control every stage — from material selection to printing. No intermediaries, no surprises.

2.title: Fixed price
2.body: Invoice immediately after confirmation. Price doesn't change after production starts.

3.title: Personal manager
3.body: One contact from first request to order delivery. We respond within 2 hours during business hours.

3.answer: Ja. Box of Touch — fysiska prover på tyger, färger och produkter.
